title: C RPL: rpl_routing ztest suite additions (297 lines) never executed; needs native_sim/AWS run
description: Commit 65ca175106 added grouped-DAO rejections, cycle atomics, and canonical-vector coverage (dao_wire_origin) to lichen/tests/rpl_routing — a Zephyr twister suite not executable on the macOS host. The standalone rpl_dao_auth suite mirrors only the origin matrix; duplicate-target, cycle, capacity, and descriptor interactions are covered solely by the Zephyr-only suite. Run under native_sim per the EPOCH recipe on the AWS builder (matches CI) before calling the DAO-authz work verified; related beads: worker6-y7wh (native_sim matrix RUN, in progress by another session), worker6-l327 (sub-/128 delegation semantics).
